prompt: Design a broadband SPDT RF switch, DC to 110 GHz.

conversation.message: For DC–110 GHz, I’d start by comparing series–shunt and distributed implementations: series–shunt offers a clearer isolation trade-off, while distributed switching may broaden operation but requires transmission-line and EM validation. Which implementation should I develop?
I’ll use the documented series–shunt starting topology. It is an editable theoretical starting point for the DC–110 GHz brief; sizing and performance remain unvalidated.
